item.title: TPG to Acquire Majority Stake in Sabre Industries from Blackstone Energy Transition Partners
item.description: The Fort Worth- and San Francisco-based investment firm will invest through TPG Rise Climate, with Blackstone retaining a minority stake.

item.title: Fort Worth Eyes Naming Rights Deal as Part of $700M Convention Center Expansion
item.description: City officials say selling naming rights could generate up to $500,000 annually to help fund capital needs, including improvements at Will Rogers Memorial Center.

item.title: Council Pay Leads Proposed Charter Amendments Headed to Fort Worth Voters
item.description: Pay raises and process changes define the charter amendments headed to Fort Worth voters this May. The City Council is expected to formally order the election on Tuesday.

item.title: Texas Job Growth Expected to Rebound Slightly in 2026, Dallas Fed Says
item.description: After a flat 2025, economists forecast cautious improvement in Texas employment amid labor market uncertainty.

item.title: Fort Worth-Based Novaria Group Acquires Plasma Ruggedized Solutions
item.description: The acquisition expands Novaria’s surface-protection capabilities for mission-critical electronics, the company says.

item.title: HTeaO Appoints Chris Phillips as Chief Financial Officer
item.description: Restaurant finance veteran Chris Phillips joins HTeaO as CFO to oversee finance, technology, and strategic planning as the brand scales nationally.

item.title: Gyna Bivens, Longtime Fort Worth City Councilmember and Mayor Pro Tem, Dies at 71
item.description: The six-term councilmember represented Fort Worth’s East Side and Stop Six for more than a decade, leaving a lasting imprint on neighborhood revitalization, housing, and senior advocacy.

item.title: Three Strategic Moves Middle Market Leaders Are Making To Win in 2026
item.description: As uncertainty continues, middle market companies are leaning into targeted digital investments, strategic M&A, and employee financial wellness to drive long-term growth.

item.title: Texas Wesleyan Launches Online Doctoral Programs in Nursing and Education
item.description: New online doctorate programs expand advanced nursing and education pathways for working professionals.

item.title: Former UT Basketball Player Builds Growing Holistic Mental Health Practice
item.description: Vannah Hughes leads a fast-growing virtual practice focused on compulsive sexual behavior, trauma, and relationship repair — blending neuroscience, therapy, and holistic care.
